{
  "dataset_name": "phoneme",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V1 to a shifted V2, capturing the relative magnitude between the first two features.",
      "value_range": [-2.5, 5.5],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows tree models to split directly on the non-linear relationship between V1 and V2, which would otherwise require deep, complex split paths.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 / (V2 + 2.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_v4_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between V3 and V4.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.5],
      "feature_family": "linear_combination",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a pre-computed linear combination, saving the tree from having to approximate this diagonal split with multiple orthogonal splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V3 - V4"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_v3_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of the first three features, representing an overall magnitude or energy level.",
      "value_range": [-4.5, 10.5],
      "feature_family": "aggregation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives the tree a single feature to evaluate the combined strength of the primary variables, useful for broad thresholding.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 + V2 + V3"
    },
    {
      "name": "v5_squared",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Squared value of V5, emphasizing extreme deviations from zero.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps trees isolate high-magnitude outliers in V5 by stretching the scale for larger absolute values.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V5 ** 2"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_above_mean_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator if V1 is above its training set mean (0.838).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "threshold",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a strong, immediate binary split point based on the central tendency of V1.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V1 > 0.838, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v2_v3_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative interaction between V2 and V3.",
      "value_range": [-4.5, 11.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the joint effect of V2 and V3, a non-linear surface that tree models cannot easily synthesize on their own.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V2 * V3"
    },
    {
      "name": "v4_v5_max",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The maximum value between V4 and V5.",
      "value_range": [-1.2, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "aggregation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Identifies the dominant higher-order feature, allowing the tree to split on the most prominent signal among the two.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(V4, V5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v5_diff_abs",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between the first and last features (V1 and V5).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures the divergence across the feature spectrum, providing a magnitude of difference that trees can threshold effectively.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(V1 - V5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v2_ordinal_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucketing of V2 into three categories: negative, below mean, and above mean.",
      "value_range": [0, 2],
      "feature_family": "binning",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces the number of splits needed by pre-grouping V2 into meaningful ordinal ranges.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V2 < 0.0, 0, np.where(V2 < 1.27, 1, 2))"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_shifted_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Logarithmic transformation of V3 shifted by 1.5 to ensure positive values.",
      "value_range": [0.2, 1.8],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses the right tail of V3's distribution, making it easier for trees to create balanced splits across the feature's range.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(V3 + 1.5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_harmonic_resonance_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A semantic assessment of the harmonic resonance quality based on the relationship and magnitudes of the first two features (V1 and V2).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, expert-like evaluation of the lower-frequency components that might correlate with specific underlying physical or acoustic properties.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_v4_v5_spectral_complexity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Evaluates the spectral complexity and high-frequency energy distribution using the higher features (V3, V4, V5).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures complex, multi-variable patterns in the higher-order features that are difficult to express through simple deterministic formulas.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
